title: A Market Woman Rescues the Wounded Child and Episode 98 Opens

blocks.text: The attackers leave the child behind, convinced their blows have finished him. Yet he remains alive, and the story takes an unexpected turn when a passing woman carries him in a basket rather than abandoning him to the field.

She brings him toward Rudiala, where his wounds are sewn and his survival is credited to divine protection. The rescue gives the narrative a moment of mercy after prolonged pursuit, slaughter, and attempted extinction.

At the same time the page serves as a hinge into a new chapter of Sikh defiance. The survival of the child is followed by the opening of Episode 98, which introduces Bhai Bota Singh and the need for an even more public sign that the Khalsa still lives.
